description: Characters the logic tokenizer has no token for (`★ ✓ →`) do not vanish: E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT (S441 round 4 coverage invariant).
rationale: §40.8 S441 bullet: every non-whitespace, non-comment byte of a body-top run is inside a parsed statement or an E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT diagnostic — text never silently vanishes.
